title: Mall dream last night
content: For whatever reason , I dreamed that I was in a mall and not able to leave. I remember trying to get strangers to help me,and telling them where I'd parked. I was dragging myself around the floor with my arms and hands. In one part, I was standing and pulling myself by whatever immobile objects were next to me. It waves if I'd had roller skates on. I haven't been to a mall in years, and I can't skate . Maybe I hit the vale too hard last night. Also ,the mall wasn't even nice or clean . I don't need an analysis , I just thought I'd share here. Any of you dream of a nasty mall?
